column1: # Project Stump: the application partition is 3 MiB (MicroPython 1.7 MiB
# plus the Stump's code frozen into it
# partition: MicroPython's ESP32 port makes one from the end of the
# application to the end of flash at boot (ports/esp32/main.c)
# filesystem is 1 MiB on a 4 MiB WROVER and 5 MiB on an 8 MiB S3-CAM.
# Changing this table (a new "partitions" tag in stump_image.py) means an
# erase: the Provisioner then asks the setup questions again.
